title: Resistor network, Bourns 4100R DIP, isolated (circuit 1)
readingTypes: 41nnR_001_vvv: nn the pin count, 001 as the ND drawing prints circuit 1, vvv the resistance code (102 = 1 kohm)
pinRule: resistor k runs from pin k to pin nn+1-k, so a 4116R has 8 resistors, pin 1 to 16 through pin 8 to 9
datasheet: Bourns 4100R datasheet, page 2, Isolated Resistors (1 Circuit)

sources.document: Bourns 4100R Series Thick Film Molded DIPs, REV. 09/19

note: Datasheet: 4116R-1 has 8 isolated resistors; 0.25 W per resistor at 70 C. ASSUMPTION, not verified: the drawing's 001 is the older way of writing circuit code 1; the current datasheet writes 1 (1 isolated, 2 bussed, 3 dual terminator).
